scope: Public PLP HTML: all sitemap URLs, content links, and event/season/venue/league archive pagination; no login or access-control bypass.

bosch_event_coverage.source: Same complete 25-page public SportsPress snapshot; all Bosch events inspected, including events without league/season taxonomy.
bosch_event_coverage.identity_basis: All 120 Bosch event performances checked against 46 canonical players and verified identity aliases; no additional player IDs remain unidentified.

excluded_link_classes: Query-string variants, feeds, WordPress administration/login/API links and media binaries. Public SportsPress APIs reviewed separately.
Further tag/author/category archive pagination is a duplicate article index; all 25 tag/author entries in XML sitemaps were read, and none introduced a new unvisited content URL.
limitation: HTTP and body identity refer to fetched public pages only. Deleted/private pages and unknown former player identities cannot be ruled out. Full reconstruction additionally uses the explicit user-confirmed Bosch-only PLP career scope.
